purpose: Resolve the semantic theme axes at an application root, including independent color sources and neutral canvas modes.
accessibility: Expose a stable accessible name and use the semantic element for the interaction.
Preserve visible focus, keyboard reachability, and disabled or pending state semantics.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: palette
api.description: Selects the base action and accent family; categorical chart colors remain independent.

api.name: primary
api.description: Selects the independent palette source for main actions, links, and selection tokens; defaults to the base palette.

api.name: accent
api.description: Selects supporting color expression; keyboard and field focus use an independent contrast-tested role.

api.name: canvas
api.description: Selects the shared neutral canvas and surface contrast treatment independently from hue.

api.name: chartPalette
api.description: Selects the data-series colorway while preserving the five-slot chart variable contract; UI roles stay unchanged.

api.name: radiusValue
api.description: Configures an exact 0–24 px base radius and derives the hierarchical radius tokens.

api.name: motionDuration
api.description: Authored anchor for motion profiles. Short interaction roles are bounded; reveal, chart and choreography roles scale independently.
